verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that describes Adyen's developer and merchant documentation. Risk-management pages are also served as clean markdown (.md), including the risk overview, profiles, rules, lists and case management, so an agent can ingest them directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of a risk-specific section or llms-full.txt variant in the llms.txt contents, and no independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.
